Inner Planet Laser Haulers
Tested with Laser damage lvl.11 and Asteroid Prod. 3.
Speed is controlled with a simple Circuit and is hovering around 178km/s and 200km/s. The residual fuel is pumped back to the tanks when the speed is below 20km/s.

Ranging from 24 to 54 Cargo bays.
title: Inner Planet Laser Platforms
